raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The `recommend-tests-from-coverage` job in `pr-test-npu.yml` downloads the coverage baseline from the Huawei OBS bucket (`sglang-npu.obs.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/coverage/test_case_map.json`), which currently returns HTTP 403. Although the job has `continue-on-error: true`, its failure is not filtered out by the PR test health check's root-cause filter, so it cascades fast-fail to all `base-b-test-*` jobs and blocks PRs.

## Modifications

- Temporarily disable the `recommend-tests-from-coverage` job via `if: false`, keeping the original condition as a comment for easy re-enable once the OBS bucket is fixed.

Note: `analyze-failure-report` still runs (`!cancelled()` semantics tolerate skipped needs) and gracefully handles empty `coverage_paths`.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A (CI-only change)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A (CI-only change)

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

> PR title must use "[Type] scope: title" or "[Type] [Hardware] scope: title". Type must be one of: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, Chore. Scope is required and may be any module or model name, with unrestricted letter case (letters, numbers, dots, underscores, slashes, or hyphens). Hardware is optional; use a single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend. Reverts must use GitHub's default format: Revert "original title". Use one space between fields and after the colon, with a non-empty title and no leading or trailing whitespace. Examples: "[Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing", "[Feat] qwen3: Add model support", "[Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance".
Edit the title; the check reruns on its own.
